newsitem.title: FRANCE: Erap holding seeks control of Eramet board.
newsitem.headline: Erap holding seeks control of Eramet board.

text.p: The state holding Erap, which controls 55 percent of Eramet, now wants its representatives to hold the majority of seats on the board of directors of the French nickel group, Eramet said on Wednesday.

"During the board meeting, representatives of Erap have stated the intention of that majority shareholder to hold, as of the next shareholders meeting, a majority of seats on the board of directors of Eramet," Eramet said in a statement issued after its board of directors met to review 1996 results.
Eramet's 15-member board includes three Erap representatives and one member of the Bureau de Recherches Geologiques et Minieres (BRMG).
